n: 4K 2x1 DM® Essentials Scaling Auto-Switcher and Extender over CATx (DM-EXT-1021 KIT)
d: DM-EXT-1021 KIT 4K 2x1 DM® Essentials Scaling Auto-Switcher and Extender over CATx Cable

specs.label: Switcher
specs.value: 2x1 (1 input at transmitter plus 1 input at receiver x 1 output at receiver) auto-switching or manual, audio-follows-video, Crestron Auto‑Locking® and QuickSwitch HD™ technology

specs.label: Scaler, HDMI Output
specs.value: 4K video scaler with intelligent frame rate conversion, Deep Color support, content adaptive noise reduction, 3:2/2:2 pull-down detection and recovery

specs.label: Input Signal Type
specs.value: HDMI with Deep Color and 4K (DVI and Dual-Mode DisplayPort™ interface compatible)

specs.label: Output Signal Type
specs.value: HDMI with Deep Color and 4K (DVI compatible)

specs.label: Output Volume
specs.value: -80 to +20 dB level adjustment range; Independent mute for HDMI and analog audio outputs

specs.label: Analog Output Performance
specs.value: Frequency Response: 20 Hz to 20 kHz ±0.5 dB; S/N Ratio: >95 dB @ 10 dBV, 20 Hz to 20 kHz, A-weighted; THD+N: <0.005% @ 1 kHz and 10 dBV; Stereo Separation: 20 Hz to 20 kHz ≤80 dB

specs.label: Ethernet
specs.value: 100/1000 Mbps, autoswitching, autonegotiating, autodiscovery, full/half duplex, CIP, DHCP, web browser setup and control
